definitions.source:
defineEvent('sea_fog', {
  name: 'Морок',
  toast: 'С моря наползает морок — тени смелеют',
  warn: true,
  biomes: ['dusk'],
  chance: 0.25, duration: [30, 45], cooldown: 80,
  when: (c) => c.prog > 0.3,
  weather: { kind: 'sea_mist', density: 0.8, wind: [0.9, 0.3] },
  palette: { fogD: 0.05, fog: '#7d6f98', skyHor: '#a483a4', mist: 0.55, mistCol: '#b0a2cf', motes: 0.2, vig: 0.52, grain: 0.06, sunVis: 0.4 },
  ambience: { drone: 1.7, waves: 0.7, wind: 0.6 },
  spawnMul: { shade: 2 },
})

defineEvent('aurora', {
  name: 'Северное сияние',
  toast: 'Над фьордом разгорается сияние',
  biomes: ['frost'],
  chance: 0.3, duration: [30, 40], cooldown: 60,
  when: (c) => c.tod > 0.25 && c.tod < 0.7,
  weather: { kind: 'snow', density: 0.12, wind: [0.2, 0.1] },
  palette: { aurora: 1, stars: 0.8, skyTop: '#06102a', bloom: 0.9, coinGlow: 2.2, auroraA: '#3dffa8', auroraB: '#7a6bff' },
  paletteMix: 1,
  ambience: { wind: 0.5, drone: 0.6 },
})
